ann.t: General Updates — Indusind Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Newspaper clippings pertaining to the Unaudited Consolidated and Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30,  2026

Press Release — Indusind Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 23, 2026, titled "INDUSIND BANK LIMITED ANNOUNCES FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2026".
Outcome of Board Meeting — IndusInd Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Unaudited Consolidated and Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
Copy of Newspaper Publication — IndusInd Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about the copy of Newspaper Publication of Financial Results for the Quarter Ended June 30, 2026

Press Release — IndusInd Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 22, 2026, titled "INDUSIND BANK LIMITED ANNOUNCES FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER ENDED June 30, 2026".
Outcome of Board Meeting — IndusInd Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.

Cessation — IndusInd Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of  Mr. Pradeep Udhas  as   Non-Executive Independent Director  of the Bank, with effect from the close of working hours on Monday, June 8, 2026, upon completion of his tenure.
Press Release — Press Release   Audited Consolidated and Standalone Financial Results of the Bankfor the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026
Outcome of Board Meeting — IndusInd Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.

Press Release — Indusind Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated January 23, 2026, titled "Unaudited Consolidated and Standalone Financial Results of the Bank for the quarter and nine months ended December 31 2025".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Indusind Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.

News Verification — The Exchange has sought clarification from Indusind Bank Limited with respect to recent news item captioned IndusInd Bank Under SFIO Scanner As MCA Orders Probe Citing Public Interest..  The response from the Company is attached.
